what_this_is: The settings check_switches.py run uses when the session names none (CHECK_LIST_SETTINGS): the door and the key come from the session's environment, CHECK_LIST_DOOR (the person's door, https://<door>/mcp) and CHECK_LIST_KEY (the session's own key), so no repository names anyone's door. Without them every tool call says check list unreachable. The check rows (record:check, read with the door's where { kind: check }, kept as `checks` in the snapshot) are judged by check_rows.judge on each call: a Bash command matching a unit_kinds row's acts_on (the command match a hook-guard row's acts_on uses) is judged as that kind (git-commit, git-push), any other call as `otherwise` (tool-call); only rows whose kinds name the kind are kept.
